If your business depends too much on you, or one key person, buyers see risk.

In this video, Hayden explains how process documentation reduces key person risk, makes a business easier to delegate, and gives buyers more confidence that the company can keep working after the owner steps away.

You’ll learn why documentation is not just an SOP exercise, how buyers look for hidden owner dependency during diligence, and how AI can help turn tribal knowledge into usable systems faster.

*Run the Key Person Risk Assessment here:*
https://el-key-person-risk-assessment.vercel.app/assessment

The goal is simple: identify what would break if one person left, then document the highest-risk work first.
